why: NOTES-FROM-PLANNING.md entries 150 and 168. A release exists only when something that ships inside the
executable or its package changed. Entry 150 classified by top level directory and counted tests, scripts
and the workflows as shipping, so nightly 94 was built from a test, a site script and the log splitter,
and its own notes said nothing in it changed the application.
Three classes now. ships is not written here by hand: scripts/shipping-gate.py --generate asks MSBuild
what dotnet publish of the application reads and writes .github/shipping-generated.json, and adds the
files below under ships-packaging, which the packaging scripts copy and MSBuild never sees. Every other
path takes the class of its top level entry from checked or content. A path in no class is a failure.
rule: A path matched by the generated ships list ships. Otherwise its top level entry decides: checked or content.

ships-packaging.LICENSE: copied beside the executable in every package
ships-packaging.THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md: copied beside the executable in every package
ships-packaging.scripts/package-windows.ps1: builds the Windows zip and installer
ships-packaging..github/workflows/package.yml: decides what goes into every package on every platform
ships-packaging.samples/gl-cf25-ltr-d-25-shots-600-dpi.p: copied into the Windows package as the shot sample
ships-packaging.samples/PROVENANCE.md: copied into the Windows package beside the sample
ships-packaging.scans/phase0/gl-cf25-ltr-1-300-dpi.png: copied into the Windows package as the unshot sample
ships-packaging.Directory.Build.props: the version the build is named from, and the compiler settings
ships-packaging.nuget.config: where the packages the executable contains are restored from
ships-packaging.src/GroupLab.App/Assets/icons/grouplab.i: copied into the macOS application bundle by scripts/macos-bundle.py

checked..gitattributes: line endings at checkout; a test has failed over CRLF on a Windows runner, so CI runs, and nothing ships
checked..github: the workflows: CI runs on a change to them, and only package.yml, listed above, changes a package
checked.Directory.Build.props: listed here for its top level class; it ships through ships-packaging
checked.Directory.Build.targets: build settings; MSBuild reports it as read, so it ships through the generated list
checked.GroupLab.slnx: which projects the suite builds; the published project does not read it
checked.LICENSE: listed here for its top level class; it ships through ships-packaging
checked.THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md: listed here for its top level class; it ships through ships-packaging
checked.nuget.config: listed here for its top level class; it ships through ships-packaging
checked.packaging: listed here for its top level class; it ships through ships-packaging
checked.reference: ballistics reference data the tests measure against
checked.samples: sample sheets the tests decode; the two the package copies ship through ships-packaging
checked.scans: the real scans the detection tests run against
checked.scripts: build, release and site tooling; the two packaging scripts ship through ships-packaging
checked.src: the source; everything the build reads ships through the generated list, and the rest is checked
checked.targets: target definitions; the ones the application reads ship through the generated list
checked.tests: the tests: CI runs them and a failure blocks main, and nothing in them ships
checked.tools: the reference encoder the fixtures are dumped from

content.CLAUDE.md: the rules this session works to, read by nobody at runtime
content.README.md: documentation, and the site reads it
content.docs: documentation, the release notes, the guides and the research articles
